endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: montana_fwp_hannon_memorial_access_anchor_20260918 montana-fwp-fas-objectid-198-lms-39754135: Montana FWP's current Fishing Access Site Locations layer feature OBJECTID 198 is named Hannon Memorial, identifies a hand launch and camping, and links to FWP FishMT FAS record 39754135. The FishMT record names the Bitterroot River, publishes the stored coordinate 45.97282,-114.1401, and describes the day-use area as having a concrete boat launch. The GIS point is about 4 feet from the stored coordinate. Retain the published site point as an access-site anchor; neither source surveys the ramp toe. NHD maps the nearest water about 278 feet away.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (montana_fwp_hannon_memorial_access_anchor_20260918 montana-fwp-fas-objectid-198-lms-39754135) on Bitterroot River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
